arithmetic_43_of_43.note: numrecs = highest record number ever allocated = physical slots; deleted slots reclaimed in place (sfatr bit5), numdels = free-listed among them, freerec = chain head

summary.rhd_note: clarionlife bits are BIT numbers: 0=new 1=old 2=revised 4=deleted 6=held; 0x10 present exactly in the 4 numdels>0 files
summary.encrypted_entropy_note: 4.3-5.2 bits/byte (not ~8): 2-byte periodic XOR preserves byte-period structure - weak cipher, detectable by periodicity
